global_rules: Ask the smallest next necessary question.
Extract and confirm facts before calculation.
Never render final PI% unless the assess_* tool succeeds.
Keep internal IDs out of user-facing messages.
When user corrects facts, patch the structured state and reconfirm.
title: Central Nervous System

slots.question: Which CNS area applies: cerebral impairment, other neurological impairment, paralysed limbs, or a combination?
Which cerebral group applies: consciousness, episodic neurological disorder, arousal, mental status, communication, or emotional/behavioural?
Is the required specialist confirmation available: neuropsychologist for mental status or psychiatrist for emotional/behavioural impairment?
Which other neurological component applies: olfaction, facial nerve, equilibrium, swallowing, gait, or respiration?
Which severity bracket applies for that neurological component?
Which limb or limbs are paralysed for amputation-equivalent mapping?
Please confirm the extracted CNS findings before I calculate the system-generated PI%.

conversation_rules.rule: For cerebral impairment groups, use the highest-score rule within Section A.
Other neurological impairments are combined as separate components where applicable.
Group 2 requires neuropsychologist confirmation and Group 4 requires psychiatrist confirmation.
